title: Compare a battle-rule cheat on an isolated EUR checkpoint
changes: Record a same-seed CH-0338 memory and persistence comparison in EUR DS-05.
validation: Protected Wine/Xvfb candidate and control: one-frame candidate application recorded eight writes and changed the first target 4 to 0; control remained 4, and values persisted over 120 neutral frames after disarm. Screens appeared alike; both runs closed normally and Wine drained (dbg22-laws-paired-4x_rxqeo).

A protected same-seed EUR/Wine pair followed the verified deployment and battle route to System → Laws: the control displayed Cavalleria forbidden and Carica recommended; the candidate showed empty rows after one application and disarm. The target stayed zero versus 4 at the same final frame; clocks differed by one cycle (dbg22-laws-view-paired-kxaq5zm3).
limitations: This observes displayed rule and recommendation changes in one scene, not actual rule enforcement, all side effects, native Windows or original hardware.
